steps.en: Officer opens the witness summons application function
steps.id: Officer membuka fungsi permohonan summon witness
steps.why_en: The system has no witness summons application screen.
steps.why_id: Sistem tidak punya layar permohonan summon witness.

steps.en: Officer searches by ID number, summons number or notice number
steps.id: Officer mencari dengan nomor ID, nomor summons atau nomor notice
steps.why_en: A general notice search exists, but it is not tied to a witness application.
steps.why_id: Ada pencarian notice umum, tapi tidak terhubung ke permohonan witness.

steps.why_en: Results are a general notice list, not a witness-application list.
steps.why_id: Hasilnya daftar notice umum, bukan daftar permohonan witness.
